matthew.26.p1.b1.text: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, He told His disciples,

matthew.26.p1.b2.text: “You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”

matthew.26.p1.b3.text: At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

matthew.26.p1.b4.text: But not during the feast … or there may be a riot among the people.

matthew.26.p2.b1.text: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,

matthew.26.p2.b2.text: a woman came to Him with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume

matthew.26.p2.b3.text: which she poured on His head as He reclined at the table.

matthew.26.p3.b1.text: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant and asked

matthew.26.p3.b3.text: This perfume could have been sold at a high price, and the money given to the poor.”

matthew.26.p4.b1.text: Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.

matthew.26.p4.b2.text: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.

matthew.26.p4.b3.text: By pouring this perfume on Me, she has prepared My body for burial.

matthew.26.p4.b4.text: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”

matthew.26.p5.b1.text: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

matthew.26.p5.b2.text: What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?

matthew.26.p5.b3.text: And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver.

matthew.26.p5.b4.text: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus.

matthew.26.p6.b1.text: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread

matthew.26.p6.b2.text: Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?

matthew.26.p6.b3.text: the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.

matthew.26.p6.b4.text: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.

matthew.26.p7.b1.text: When evening came, Jesus was reclining with the twelve disciples.

matthew.26.p7.b2.text: Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.

matthew.26.p8.b1.text: The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.

matthew.26.p8.b2.text: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”

matthew.26.p9.b1.text: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples

matthew.26.p9.b2.text: Take and eat; this is My body.

matthew.26.p9.b3.text: Drink from it, all of you.

matthew.26.p9.b4.text: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

matthew.26.p10.b1.text: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom.”

matthew.26.p10.b2.text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

matthew.26.p11.b1.text: This very night you will all fall away on account of Me.

matthew.26.p11.b2.text: For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

matthew.26.p11.b3.text: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”

matthew.26.p12.b1.text: Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.

matthew.26.p12.b2.text: Truly I tell you … this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.

matthew.26.p12.b3.text: Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.

matthew.26.p12.b4.text: And all the other disciples said the same thing.

matthew.26.p13.b1.text: At that time Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane

matthew.26.p13.b2.text: Sit here while I go over there and pray.

matthew.26.p13.b3.text: My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.

matthew.26.p14.b1.text: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed

matthew.26.p14.b2.text: My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me.

matthew.26.p14.b3.text: Yet not as I will, but as You will.

matthew.26.p15.b1.text: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping.

matthew.26.p15.b2.text: Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?

matthew.26.p15.b3.text: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.

matthew.26.p15.b4.text: For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.

matthew.26.p16.b1.text: A second time He went away and prayed

matthew.26.p16.b2.text: My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.

matthew.26.p16.b3.text: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping—for their eyes were heavy.

matthew.26.p16.b4.text: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time, saying the same thing.

matthew.26.p17.b1.text: Are you still sleeping and resting?

matthew.26.p17.b2.text: Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

matthew.26.p17.b3.text: Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!”

matthew.26.p18.b1.text: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs …

matthew.26.p18.b2.text: The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.

matthew.26.p18.b4.text: Friend … do what you came for.

matthew.26.p19.b1.text: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

matthew.26.p19.b2.text: Put your sword back in its place … For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

matthew.26.p19.b3.text: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

matthew.26.p19.b4.text: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”

matthew.26.p20.b1.text: Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?

matthew.26.p20.b2.text: Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.

matthew.26.p20.b3.text: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.

matthew.26.p20.b4.text: Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.

matthew.26.p21.b1.text: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to the house of Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and elders had gathered.

matthew.26.p21.b2.text: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest.

matthew.26.p21.b3.text: And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.

matthew.26.p22.b1.text: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.

matthew.26.p22.b2.text: and declared, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”

matthew.26.p22.b3.text: Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?

matthew.26.p23.b1.text: I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.

matthew.26.p23.b3.text: But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.

matthew.26.p24.b1.text: He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses?

matthew.26.p24.b3.text: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?”

matthew.26.p25.b1.text: You also were with Jesus the Galilean

matthew.26.p25.b2.text: I do not know what you are talking about.

matthew.26.p25.b3.text: This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.

matthew.26.p25.b4.text: I do not know the man!

matthew.26.p26.b1.text: Surely you are one of them … for your accent gives you away.

matthew.26.p26.b2.text: I do not know the man!

matthew.26.p26.b4.text: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
